text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma. The combination of painless progressive jaundice, pruritus, weight loss, pale stools, and dark urine in a 72-year-old heavy smoker is classic for a pancreatic head tumor obstructing the common bile duct.
